author: sandmrk
text:
Muse Video Prompt
Format lock: Aspect ratio 16:9 (source 1920×1080, 30 fps; generate at 1920×1080, 30 fps) — the output MUST use exactly this 16:9 horizontal ratio; no cropping, no reframing, no letterbox change.

Master (include with every clip):
Identity & costume lock: Character A — ARIA, an elven maiden: long straight blonde hair to the waist, long pointed ears angled up and out, green eyes, fair skin; a fine silver brow-chain with one green teardrop gem at the center of her forehead, silver leaf hair ornaments, long dangling earrings with green gems, a fine silver necklace with a small green pendant. Her forest dress (Clips 1–8): a dark-green velvet sweetheart bodice embroidered with silver leaves and vines, detached sheer dark-green chiffon sleeves with silver leaf appliqué, brown leather shorts, a brown leather thigh strap on her left thigh, bare feet. Her valley dress (Clips 9–12): a flowing ivory-white sheer gown, a sage-green sash ribbon at the waist, thin silver-strap sandals; same brow-chain, earrings and necklace. Faint scratches and dirt smudges on her cheeks and shoulders from the fall stay constant from Clip 1 until the valley dress. Her identity is locked from every angle used in this film — front, three-quarter, profile, overhead top-down and low-angle POV: the same woman in every shot. Character B — GRU, a goblin: grey-green skin, bald crown with thin black hair only at the sides and back, very large pointed ears flaring sideways with notched tips, two small lower fangs curving up past his upper lip, amber eyes, a long nose, a lean wiry body; a cord necklace with a smooth gold egg-shaped pendant that never leaves his chest. Clips 1–7: bare torso, ragged brown cloth shorts. Clips 8–12: he adds a coarse grey hooded cloak over a ragged beige tunic, a brown belt with a small pouch. Same face and proportions from every angle used — front, three-quarter, profile, overhead top-down. Supporting elves (Clips 9–10 only): a red-haired elven girl with twin buns; a tall elven leader woman, hair in a high braided ponytail, high-collared dark-green embroidered robe; a silver-haired elven man in a dark-green cloak; several spear- and sword-bearing elves behind them, kept out of focus. Prop lock: the gold egg pendant — on Gru's chest in every shot he appears in, never duplicated, never removed; the tall wicker basket — Clip 4 carried empty on his back, Clip 6 overflowing with wildflowers, absent after Clip 6; the straw bunny doll — Clip 2 only, in Gru's hands by the fire; the woven herb basket — Clip 2 only, on the cave floor; the glowing green salve — Clip 3 only, a small green glow at his fingertip on her ankle, gone by Clip 4.
World & scenes: Scene A — the mist forest (day): a colossal moss-covered ancient tree with a horizontal branch, layered mist, a green valley far below; yellow-green field, god rays through the canopy. Scene B — Gru's cave (warm interior): rock walls, a hay bed with burlap blanket and pillow, a stone fire pit with a steaming hanging pot at frame left, woven floor mats, wooden shelves with clay pots and woven animal figures, bundles of dried herbs hanging from a pole; amber-orange firelit field. Scene C — the flower meadow (day): waist-high wildflowers in white, pink, yellow and violet at a sunlit forest edge; golden field. Scene D — the Elven Valley overlook (day): waterfalls and a tree-city on cliffs; blue-green field. Scene E — the valley-mouth clearing (day, one time-lapse cycle inside a single locked shot, then morning): mossy ground, pine trunks, the valley behind. Composition rule: dialogue plays in medium close-ups and close-ups, face height 25–45 percent of frame height in close-ups; the flower-field lying shots and the death shot are overhead top-down; the two POV beats (Clip 6's promise, Clips 11–12's confession) are shot from Gru's eye level looking up at her.
replies:
CAMERA — transcribed from the original: cinematic and patient; tripod-still or the slowest push-in on faces; at most one motivated move per shot; hard cuts between shots, no transitions except the two noted fades (Clip 4's cave-mouth darkness, Clip 6's closing fade); every shot's camera behavior is written in its shot line.
THE RHYTHM & FORCE: a dialogue film cut at conversation speed — 50 shots over 117 seconds, average shot length about 2.3 seconds; nobody fights and nothing is rushed; the force lives in reversals of expression, and every emotional turn lands in the eyes first and only a beat later in the body — if any character moves the body before the face has changed, it is wrong. The fall in Clip 1 is the film's only fast motion: a genuine tumble with moss compression and a roll, never a graceful float.
EMOTION ARC: her fall into his world → fear of the "vile goblin" → trust built from small kindnesses → open joy and a spoken promise → her people arrive and the promise is publicly revoked → she chooses her standing over his life → his forgiveness, her cold absolution of herself. Clip landings: Clip 1 wonder and accident; Clip 2 fear misreading kindness; Clip 3 fear thawing into puzzlement; Clip 4 delight and gratitude; Clip 5 pride softening into play; Clip 6 the promise, meant fully; Clip 7 intimacy in the flowers; Clip 8 hope answered with a vow; Clip 9 the waiting and the betrayal; Clip 10 the sentence and her silence; Clip 11 his absolution of her; Clip 12 her absolution of herself.
Lighting & grade: one warm-natural cinematic grade across the whole film. Scene A/C daylight is motivated canopy sun — soft, high, dappled, gentle contrast, shadow detail kept. Scene B is motivated by the fire pit only — low amber key from frame left, deep warm shadows, no other source. Scene D/E morning backlight, ending on sun flare through pines. Skin never plastic; the forest never collapses into a flat teal block; each scene holds its stated color field.
Sound — Hollywood-grade sound design (all synthesized; no music anywhere): Bed — canopy birdsong and leaf-wind (Scenes A/C/E), cave fire crackle with a slow water drip (Scene B), meadow insects low under dialogue (Clips 6–7), waterfall white noise far behind Scene D. Foley, each named: bark scraping under palms, moss compressing under bodies, cloth and straw rustle, bare feet on grass and on stone, wicker weave creaking under load, clay pot ticks, fingertip strokes of salve, sandals on moss. Designed FX — the fall: a rising leaf-rustle whoosh cut dead at impact; the salve glow: a tiny glass-harmonic shimmer that blooms and decays within two seconds; the time-lapse: wind stretched long and thin across one shot. Voice — cast and ADR: Aria, a young female Mandarin voice, bright and clear, petulant in the early clips, softening through the middle, level and cold in Clips 9–12; Gru, a low slow male Mandarin voice, slightly hoarse, words spaced, never raised; the Leader, a cold female alto; the red-haired girl, a sharp young female voice. All dialogue close and dry, location-natural, lips moving syllable by syllable in sync, every spoken line delivered front-facing or three-quarter, never in profile. Mix: dialogue always on top, beds duck under lines; two deliberate silences are protected — Clip 10 after the death sentence (her reaction, no line) and Clip 12 mid-monologue (eyes closed, one full breath). No music anywhere.

Clip 1 (source 0:00–0:10):
[0.0–2.0s] Shot 1 — Medium close, slight handheld sway: on a moss-covered horizontal branch of the ancient tree, Aria hangs upside down beneath the branch, her inverted face swinging into frame between leaves, blonde hair falling toward the ground far below; she grips the bark and hauls herself up, ending prone on top of the branch, hair spilling over the moss. Avoid: graceful acrobatics, the branch bending like rubber.

[2.0–3.3s] Shot 2 — Close insert, static (hard cut): her bare feet and ankles dangle below the branch, swaying gently against the misty valley. Avoid: shoes appearing, extra legs.
[3.3–4.9s] Shot 3 — Medium, static (hard cut): she sits up astride the branch and looks around the canopy, smiling dreamily — the smile in her eyes first, mouth corners barely lifting. Avoid: posing for the camera, a wide grin.
[4.9–5.5s] Shot 4 — Medium, static (hard cut): still laughing, she leans back too far and tips off the branch, falling down out of frame with real motion blur. Avoid: slow-motion floating, a controlled jump.
[5.5–7.2s] Shot 5 — Wide, static (hard cut): the mossy forest floor; Gru's out-of-focus head and shoulder fill the right foreground, his gaze fixed left where Aria tumbles into view, rolls once through the moss — the moss visibly compresses under the roll — and comes to rest lying still, eyes closed. Avoid: Gru in focus in this shot, a soft feather landing.
[7.2–8.1s] Shot 6 — Medium close, static (hard cut): Gru front-facing, amber eyes wide with shock, mouth open showing his small fangs, the gold egg pendant on his bare chest; a beat held. Avoid: menace in his face, the pendant missing.
[8.1–10.0s] Shot 7 — Face close-up, slowest push-in of about 10 percent (hard cut): Aria asleep on the moss, cheek scratches visible, breathing slow and even, hair spread on the green. End state: her sleeping face fills the frame; the next clip opens on the same face waking in the cave. Avoid: her waking here, beauty-filter skin.
Sound: Bed — canopy birdsong, leaf-wind; Foley — bark under her palms, cloth on moss, the roll's soft thuds; Designed FX — the fall's leaf-rustle whoosh rising at 4.9s and cut dead at the landing; no dialogue; no music.
Avoid (clip): extra characters, a second fall, the pendant on anyone but Gru.

Clip 2 (source 0:10–0:20):
[0.0–3.3s] Shot 8 — Medium, static: Scene B, the cave; Aria wakes on the hay bed under the burlap blanket, eyes opening on the rock ceiling, then pushes herself up on one elbow, bewildered, face three-quarter to camera; Dialogue — Aria: "哪里？" Avoid: her sitting bolt upright, modern bedding.
[3.3–5.2s] Shot 9 — Wide, static (hard cut): the whole cave; Gru in the foreground with his back to camera, holding the straw bunny doll, the fire pot steaming at frame left; Aria small on the bed at frame right background, one hand to her forehead; Dialogue — Aria: "一个哥布林的洞穴。" Avoid: Gru turning to camera, the doll becoming a real rabbit.
[5.2–7.2s] Shot 10 — Medium with a slight downward tilt (hard cut): she sits on the bed edge, swings her legs down and tries to stand; her ankle buckles and she catches herself on the bed frame. Avoid: a graceful recovery, shoes.
[7.2–10.0s] Shot 11 — Medium, static (hard cut): she has sunk onto the woven floor mat, half-crawling, looking up in alarm; beside the herb basket Gru turns toward her with a wide fanged grin; Dialogue — Gru: "精灵小姐" then, still grinning: "你现在可走不了" (the grin is innocent friendliness that she misreads as threat — play it innocent). End state: she is on the floor mat looking up at him in fear. Avoid: an actually evil expression on him, her standing.
Sound: Bed — fire crackle, one slow cave drip; Foley — straw bed rustle, burlap sliding, her palm slapping the mat, basket weave creak; Voice — her waking line small and lost, his lines warm and pleased under the grin; no dialogue from anyone else; no music.
Avoid (clip): the fire becoming a bonfire, any subtitle or text on screen, the bunny doll reappearing after this clip.

Clip 3 (source 0:20–0:30):
[0.0–3.3s] Shot 12 — Close, static: Aria on the mat staring up at him; fear and disgust move through her face — brows rising, nose wrinkling — as she mutters half to herself; Dialogue — Aria: "笑的这么猥琐" then, panic rising: "完了完了". Avoid: shouting, comic exaggeration.

[3.3–5.2s] Shot 13 — Extreme close-up, static (hard cut): her face only; tears well, her eyes squeeze shut, one tear escapes; her breathing shakes. Avoid: sobbing, mascara streaks.
[5.2–7.5s] Shot 14 — Medium close, static (hard cut): she sits with eyes lowered, listening; Gru stays off-screen, his voice gentle; Dialogue — Gru (off-screen): "精灵小姐，你大可放心吧" and "我不会对你怎么样". Avoid: Gru entering the frame, her looking at camera.
[7.5–10.0s] Shot 15 — Two-shot at floor level, static (hard cut): Gru kneels before her raised foot, head bowed in concentration, and spreads the glowing green salve over her ankle with two fingers — the glow blooms softly and settles (this clip only); she watches him, fear draining into puzzlement; Dialogue — Gru: "我叫格鲁" and "我喜欢编织一些小玩偶". Avoid: the glow spreading beyond the ankle, romantic framing.
Sound: Foley — cloth shifting on the mat, his fingertip strokes; Designed FX — the salve's glass-harmonic shimmer blooms and decays under his second line; Voice — her mutters low and fast, his lines slow and unhurried; no music.
Avoid (clip): the salve glow in any later clip, her ankle still injured after Clip 4, any third person in the cave.

Clip 4 (source 0:30–0:40):
[0.0–1.5s] Shot 16 — Ankle close-up, static: his green hand finishes the last stroke on her ankle, the glow already gone; her toes flex once; Dialogue — Gru: "人族小孩可喜欢了". Avoid: the glow returning.
[1.5–3.5s] Shot 17 — Medium, static (hard cut): Gru stands and walks out of frame right with the herb basket; Aria sits hugging one knee on the mat, watching the empty space; Dialogue — Gru (off-screen): "等你伤好了能走了" and "你再离开吧". Avoid: her following him, the pendant on anyone else.
[3.5–5.6s] Shot 18 — Medium close, static (hard cut): she lifts her foot toward the camera, wiggles her toes and rotates the healed ankle; delight breaks across her face — eyes bright first, then a real smile; Dialogue — Aria: "你这哥布林还挺好". Avoid: the foot touching the lens, an exaggerated grin.
[5.6–6.7s] Shot 19 — Fade through near-black: the cave darkens to almost nothing, then daylight grows — the cave mouth. The only fade in this stretch.
[6.7–9.0s] Shot 20 — Wide, static: outside the cave mouth; Gru walks out into the light carrying the tall empty wicker basket on his back; Aria hurries after him, ankle sound; Dialogue — Aria: "格鲁，带上我呗". Avoid: the basket already full of flowers, her limping.
[9.0–10.0s] Shot 21 — Profile close, static (hard cut): her profile against the cave-mouth light, listening; Dialogue — Gru (off-screen): "有点远". End state: her profile lit at the cave mouth; the next clip opens on her turning front. Avoid: her face turning front within this shot.
Sound: Bed — the fire dies under the fade, replaced by morning birdsong at the cave mouth; Foley — basket straps creaking, bare feet on stone then grass; Voice — his off-screen lines unhurried, her call after him bright; no music.
Avoid (clip): any return to the cave interior after the fade, the herb basket reappearing.

Clip 5 (source 0:40–0:50):
[0.0–2.6s] Shot 22 — Medium close, static: at the cave mouth she turns front, chin up — affronted pride in her eyes a beat before her mouth moves; Dialogue — Aria: "别小看我" and "我可是精灵族". Avoid: anger that reads as real hostility.
[2.6–4.6s] Shot 23 — Medium close, static (hard cut): she faces the camera (his position), winks once and flashes a two-finger peace sign, playful and modern against the ancient forest; Dialogue — Gru (off-screen): "听你的，精灵小姐". Avoid: a second wink, the gesture held past its beat.
[4.6–5.6s] Shot 24 — Close, static (hard cut): Gru scratches the side of his bald head, sheepish, grinning with his fangs, basket strap on his shoulder. Avoid: menace, the pendant swinging out of place.
[5.6–8.4s] Shot 25 — Face close-up, slight push-in (hard cut): on the forest path Aria leans toward camera — scolding first, brows knit and lip pursed, then the scold melts

into a bright instructive smile as she taps her own chest; face front throughout, lips moving syllable by syllable; Dialogue — Aria: "别叫我精灵小姐了" then "难听死了" then, proudly: "我叫艾莉亚，记住喽". Avoid: her looking away mid-line, a coy head tilt.
[8.4–10.0s] Shot 26 — Medium tracking, camera moving with her (hard cut): Scene C; she breaks into a run through the wildflower meadow, leaping once over a flower clump, hair streaming; she calls back over her shoulder; Dialogue — Aria: "格鲁" and, mid-run at three-quarter face: "我感觉到自由的风填满了我的胸膛". End state: her running right-to-left through the flowers; the next clip opens on him trudging behind. Avoid: slow-motion running, a dance-like pose.
Sound: Bed — meadow insects, wind in flowers; Foley — her feet swishing through stems, dress rustle; Voice — the name line delivered straight to camera with a teacher's emphasis on the name; no music.
Avoid (clip): any modern object besides the single peace-sign gesture, Gru keeping up with her effortlessly.

Clip 6 (source 0:50–1:00):
[0.0–3.2s] Shot 27 — Medium, slow lateral track: Gru bent nearly double under the wicker basket now overflowing with wildflowers, trudging after her, breath short; Dialogue — Gru: "艾莉亚，我追不上你了". Avoid: the basket shrinking, him standing upright and strong.
[3.2–4.7s] Shot 28 — Close insert, static (hard cut): her open hand reaches into frame toward camera, palm up, fingers relaxed — an offered hand and nothing else in frame. Avoid: a second hand, her jewelry changing.
[4.7–7.9s] Shot 29 — Medium close from his eye level, static (hard cut): she stands before the camera with her hand extended toward the lens, sunlit; earnest — her eyes hold the lens (him) for the whole line, the smile arriving only after the words; Dialogue — Aria: "格鲁，我永远不会抛弃你". End state: her smiling face, hand still extended. Avoid: her hand touching or covering the lens, a flirtatious wink.
[7.9–9.8s] Shot 30 — Close, static (hard cut): Gru's face, basket strap across his shoulder; his amber eyes go wet, fangs hidden as his mouth softens — overwhelmed, and he says nothing. Avoid: tears streaming, a grin.
[9.8–10.0s] Shot 31 — Fade to near-black over his face; her voice comes out of the darkness; Dialogue — Aria (off-screen): "格鲁". Avoid: full black held longer than a breath.
Sound: Foley — basket weave groaning under the flower weight, his trudging steps in grass; Mix — the meadow bed thins to almost nothing under her promise; Voice — his line breathless and honest, her promise steady and plain, the final call soft; no music.
Avoid (clip): the promise played as romance poster — it is earnest, not seductive; the basket losing its flowers.

Clip 7 (source 1:00–1:10):
[0.0–3.3s] Shot 32 — Overhead top-down close, static (opening on the state Clip 6 faded out on): both lie side by side in the flower field, shot from directly above; Gru's face fills the left of frame among daisies, gazing up past camera; Aria's shoulder and hair edge the right; her voice is soft and close; Dialogue — Aria: "虽然你呆呆的不爱讲话" and "但是你在身边我很开心"; on the second line his mouth opens into a slow fanged smile, eyes crinkling. Avoid: either of them sitting up, the camera drifting.

[3.3–4.8s] Shot 33 — Overhead top-down, static (hard cut): Aria lying in the flowers, hair spread, looking up; Dialogue — Aria: "我都不知道怎么报答你好了". Avoid: a seductive pose, wandering hands.
[4.8–7.5s] Shot 34 — Side close, static (hard cut): her head rests on her arm in the flowers, face three-quarter toward him off-frame right, warm and a little shy; Dialogue — Aria: "格鲁，要不你跟我回精灵谷吧". Avoid: her face turning to camera for this line.
[7.5–10.0s] Shot 35 — Two-shot side view, static (hard cut): both lying in the flowers, him in the foreground gazing at the sky, her behind him propped on one elbow watching him; Dialogue — Gru: "艾莉亚" and "谢谢你的好意" and, quieter, "但是我相貌丑陋" trailing into "族长说…" (the sentence is left unfinished, exactly as in the source). End state: both still lying in the flowers, his gaze on the sky. Avoid: him turning to face her, her interrupting.
Sound: Bed — insects and a light breeze, closer and more intimate than Clip 6; Foley — flower stems shifting under their weight; Voice — her lines unhurried and near, his spaced and low; no music.
Avoid (clip): the overhead shots tilting into ordinary angles, the pendant hidden under his body.

Clip 8 (source 1:10–1:20):
[0.0–2.2s] Shot 36 — Face close-up from above, static: Gru lying in the flowers, looking up past camera; the self-deprecation leaves his face as he says the truest thing he has; Dialogue — Gru: "但是我感受到了" and "你的心灵，很美". Avoid: a smile undercutting the line, tears.
[2.2–4.6s] Shot 37 — Close, static (hard cut; time has passed — he now wears the grey hooded cloak over the tunic): Gru front-facing in soft forest light, hope making him younger; Dialogue — Gru: "我真的可以吗？". Avoid: the hood shadowing his eyes, the pendant hidden by the cloak — it sits over the tunic.
[4.6–5.8s] Shot 38 — Whip-pan blur (hard cut): the forest smears sideways and resolves into Scene D — the Elven Valley, waterfalls falling past tree-houses on the cliffs. Avoid: any figure in the vista, a slow scenic pan.
[5.8–10.0s] Shot 39 — Face close-up, static: Aria before the blurred waterfalls, in the valley dress, morning light on her face; she asks it like a vow, then a soft smile seals it; Dialogue — Aria: "格鲁，你一定等我出来好吗". End state: her smiling face held; the next clip opens on him standing alone in the clearing. Avoid: doubt or coldness in this beat — she means it here.
Sound: Foley — flower stems, cloak cloth; Designed FX — the whip-pan carries one wind rush that dies into waterfall white noise under her line; Voice — his question barely above a whisper, hers clear and warm; no music.
Avoid (clip): the green forest dress appearing after this clip, the valley vista lingering past its beat.

Clip 9 (source 1:20–1:30):
[0.0–2.1s] Shot 40 — Full shot, locked static (a time-lapse inside one unbroken shot): Gru stands centered in the clearing in cloak and tunic, pendant on his chest, motionless, while the light cycles around him — day to amber dusk to night, the valley windows kindling behind him, to pale morning; he does not move through the whole cycle.
